skills.name: listmonk
skills.description: Python client for a self-hosted Listmonk email server: subscribers, mailing lists, campaigns, templates, media, and transactional email, built on httpx2 and Pydantic. Use when adding listmonk to a Python app, writing code that calls listmonk.* functions, choosing between transactional subscriber modes or campaign status calls, or when a call raises OperationNotAllowedError, httpx2.HTTPStatusError (403 Forbidden, 400 No known subscribers to test), or listmonk.errors.ValidationError.
